# IDEA_LOCK.md — <gate name>

> Produced by `/idea-lock` on \<date\>. The contract. Once locked, ideation does NOT reopen without new evidence.

```text
ONE-LINE PROMISE:
  <User> struggles to <job> because <obstacle>, which causes <cost>.
  We change that by <outcome>, and what makes it different is <insight>.
  # falsifiable? gate-shaped? glance-readable? all three or rewrite.

GATE:
  name:
  state: open / closed / coming

RUBRIC MAP:
  <criterion> → <named artifact the judge sees>
  ...                                   # a line with no artifact = not ready

LOAD-BEARING ASSUMPTIONS:               # from KILL_REPORT, with spike status
  - <assumption> — spike: PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN

WHAT IS DIFFERENT:                      # from GATE_PROFILE patterns
  - ...

LOOP:
  what compounds: <...>  # or: "no loop — accepted, one-time demo"

NON-GOALS:
  - ...

PLAN SKELETON:                          # bite-sized, testable; done = judge sees it
  1. <task> — test: <what proves it>
  2. ...

EVIDENCE:
  GATE_PROFILE.md
  TERRAIN_MAP.md
  IDEA_SHORTLIST.md
  KILL_REPORT.md
  ROAST_REPORT.md
```
